messages:
nina: heads up team — StellarCorp wants the MSA amended to include a sanctions/aml screening clause and to add a new billing entity on the order form. They want two signers (legal + AP). can we do this fast?

mike_legal: short answer: yes. we'll do a one-page addendum and a DPA patch. need exact legal name + tax id for the new entity. scope AML to screening only; no broad indemnities.

harry_finance: AP will not accept Net45. finance prefers Net30. if customer insists on Net45, we'll need an approval from credit. otherwise Net30 and PO required.

tom_eng: note — we cannot provide POC infra creds until the DPA amendment covering the new entity is signed. that's a hard gating item.

rachel_cs: customer asked for DocuSign but wants HSM audit trail later. are we ok with interim DocuSign?

mike_legal: interim DocuSign acceptable but add language to allow swapping to HSM-based signature by written agreement later.

esign-bot: created envelope env-stellar-001 (orderform-stellar) for DocuSign
